primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The article identifies Hezekiah as Ahaz’s son and king of Judah. Chronicles first uses the king title for this name at 1 Chronicles 4:41, so the article/source is gated there.
wikipediaCheck.evidenceLocator: Hezekiah lead 203–207行：父アハズ、ユダ王として紹介。1歴代誌4:41も本文でヒゼキヤ王の時代と明記。
